sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
[[Dante Vale]], [[Lok Lambert]], and [[Sophie Casterwill]] were assigned to search Prague Central Cemetery and were joined by [[Zhalia Moon]].

At the cemetery, the team investigated the tomb of [[Jodis Lore]]. By rubbing clay on the tombstone and printing the symbol for 'truth' on the clay, a secret passageway was opened into Jodis Lore's  secret base.

Inside, the team found a room with a [[Mud Trap|trapped floor]] made of two types of clay: a light native clay from the Vltava River and a darker imported clay. When [[the Organization]] showed up, Lok inadvertently stepped on a patch of dark clay, activating enchanted pits of clay with magical hands that restrained and pulled down the trespassers.

With the Huntik team incapacitated, [[DeFoe]]'s [[Kreutalk]] entered the secret study and retrieved [[Jodis Lore's Key]] to the [[Golem's Attic]] and notes from the nearby study. However, Zhalia was able to create a copy thanks to an imprint left by the key on the table. {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}}.
